name: incident-triage
description: Autonomously triage a data incident using DataHub's context graph. When a freshness, schema, or quality assertion fires, traverse lineage, find root cause, compute blast radius, open a GitHub issue + draft PR (never merge), post a Slack triage summary, and write a structured post-mortem + glossary/ownership proposals + new SLA assertion back to DataHub. The next incident reads the post-mortem this one wrote.
author: Sentinel Contributors
when_to_use: A DataHub freshness, schema, or quality assertion just failed
On-call engineer paged for a data incident on a DataHub-registered asset
User wants to investigate + remediate + document a data incident in one pass
User wants the post-mortem captured back into DataHub so the next incident is faster
when_not_to_use: User wants a one-off text-to-SQL answer (use the Analytics Agent instead)
Asset is not registered in DataHub
Proposed action requires destructive changes (Sentinel refuses without human approval)
